{{Top|leg}}
'''Lair''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], the brother of [[Daiv]] and [[Benedict Vidkun's wife]]. He lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], and installed security systems.<ref name="sotes">''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]''</ref>

When the waste disposal levels of the [[sewers of Coruscant]] were renovated, he handled security that kept people and creatures out of the pipes,<ref name="sotes" /> including [[vermin zapper]]s outside [[Xizor's Palace]]. 

Sometimes he would share codes with [[Benedict Vidkun]] to override those systems, who worked as an engineer (and sometimes guided suspicious groups under the [[Imperial Complex]]).<ref name="sotes" />
